title: The advance notice couldn't be sent
story: ShopBot pays INR 1,250, but the bank couldn't deliver the required advance notice to Asha. The payment is never charged (RAIL_NOTICE_FAILED), because charging without notice would break the rules.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Allowed. Paying FreshMart now; your bank will send the advance notice first.

steps.label: Skip to the end of the notice period

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is waiting out the notice period.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Checking whether the payment went through.

what_to_notice: The pretend bank's notice-fails card shows what happens when the advance notice can't be delivered: the payment fails with RAIL_NOTICE_FAILED and is never charged, even though the Guard allowed it.
